newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks up in London after Dow opens firm.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks up in London after Dow opens firm.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks were firmer in London, led by property and bank shares after Wall Street opened on a positive note, traders said.
At 1359 GMT, the Hang Seng London Reference Index was up 13.01 points at 11,915.44.

The index fell as low as 11,873.95 earlier in the London session on profit-taking after a big rally in Hong Kong, traders said. A weak close in Hong Kong's futures market also pressured the London index, they said.
In Hong Kong, the benchmark Heng Seng index added 143.04 points to 11,902.43, the highest close since February 1994.
The market was supported by an improved outlook for interest rates and a favourable outlook for corporate earnings.
